svg.text: Stage 1: template-based localisation of the phase-locked pre-QRS (P-like) deflection
grey = all SR records with >=4 eligible beats; blue = accepted donors; dashed = donor lag range
B. template SNR: SR records (AFIB: median 1.3)
orange bar = AFIB 5-95% range (same localiser); dashed = acceptance threshold 5
samples relative to R (2 ms each)
C. accepted donors: lead II template
line = mean over donors, band = inter-quartile range
